verdict.rationale: Docusign documents generic e-signature, reusable templates, and CLM dynamic templates. Nothing in the evidence shows a built-in library of SAFE or convertible-note documents on standard terms. Its templates must be created or uploaded by the user, so they are an adjacent building block rather than the story's capability of generating standard fundraising instruments without drafting.

support.subject: As a founder, I can generate and sign SAFEs or convertible notes on standard terms without drafting from scratch
